items.acceptance_evidence: Fixed in 0d8e9af1e (`[CI-164 stacked 1/11] address Sergii review: parseRedisUrl + barrel + parallel startup`) — `new URL(url)` is now wrapped in try/catch inside the relocated `RedisTestContainer.parseUrl`, re-throwing the same diagnostic message; confirmed present in the final merged diff (base..head).
items.description: `parseRedisUrl` called `new URL(url)` with no try/catch, so a malformed `E2E_REDIS_URL` (e.g. `'plain-hostname'`) threw Node's generic `TypeError: Invalid URL` instead of going through the function's own diagnostic path that names the env var and redacts credentials. Operators debugging a bad Redis URL saw an unhelpful stock error rather than the intended guidance.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fixed in 0d8e9af1e — `parseRedisUrl` moved to a static `RedisTestContainer.parseUrl` method (spec renamed to `redis-test-container.spec.ts`); confirmed removed from `global-setup.ts` and present on `RedisTestContainer` at final head b6ae66c48c.
items.description: `parseRedisUrl` lived as a free function inside `global-setup.ts` (a composition root) instead of as a static method on `RedisTestContainer`, unlike the sibling `PostgresTestContainer.isDockerAvailable()` which is a static on its own container class. That placement meant a future change to the parsed connection shape would require edits in two files instead of one.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fixed in 0d8e9af1e (barrel re-exports added for BULLMQ_PREFIX_TOKEN/BullmqPrefix/BullmqPrefixModule/QueueRegistryService). The DI-token approach was later replaced entirely by direct EnvService injection, at which point the barrel gap was closed by exporting QueueRegistryService instead — confirmed in final queue.module.ts: `export { QueueRegistryService } from './queue-registry.service';`.
items.description: `QueueModule`'s barrel omitted re-exports for `BULLMQ_PREFIX_TOKEN` and the `BullmqPrefix` type, breaking the project's module convention (already followed by the sibling `BullBoardAuthModule`) of re-exporting DI tokens/types that are part of a module's public surface, forcing cross-module consumers to import from the internal file path directly.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fixed in 0d8e9af1e — container starts now run via `Promise.all`, with container instances assigned synchronously before any `await` so the existing abort-teardown still stops whichever container started; confirmed in final global-setup.ts diff (base..head).
items.description: `PostgresTestContainer` and `RedisTestContainer` were started sequentially in `setup()`, with Redis start gated behind Postgres start plus all migrations even though the two container starts are independent — adding roughly 2-4 seconds of unnecessary wall-clock latency to every test run.

items.acceptance_evidence: Addressed in 0d8e9af1e — explicit author reply on the thread (comment r3225290737, "Addressed in 0d8e9af1e"). JSDoc added to both `RedisContainerConfig` and `RedisContainerInfo` matching the postgres sibling's style; confirmed present in final redis-test-container.ts.
items.description: The exported `RedisContainerConfig` and `RedisContainerInfo` interfaces carried no JSDoc, even though the sibling `postgres-test-container.ts` documents the equivalent interfaces and this file's own class comment states it "Mirrors `PostgresTestContainer`".

items.acceptance_evidence: Fixed in 0d8e9af1e — bullmq-prefix.token.ts removed and the token/type folded into bullmq-prefix.module.ts above the @Module decorator, matching the existing 4/4 DI-Symbol co-location pattern. Both files were later removed entirely in a further architecture change that replaced the DI-token approach with direct EnvService injection — confirmed neither bullmq-prefix.token.ts nor bullmq-prefix.module.ts exists at final head b6ae66c48c.
items.description: The new `BULLMQ_PREFIX` DI Symbol token was placed in a dedicated `bullmq-prefix.token.ts` file, while every other existing DI Symbol token in `apps/api/src` is co-located inside a broader-purpose file (a factory, interface, or constants file) — making this the first standalone token file and a precedent for future inconsistency.

items.acceptance_evidence: Resolved by the time of 0d8e9af1e ("#7 No change required" per that commit's message, since the schema-default fix had already landed). Final api.schema.ts declares `BULLMQ_PREFIX: z.string().trim().min(1).default('bull')`, and both BullModule.forRootAsync and QueueRegistryService now read it via `env.getOrThrow('BULLMQ_PREFIX')` with no factory-level fallback. RazumRu independently confirmed this same-day in a follow-up comment (r3224692671) citing commit 9146a8fe.
items.description: The default `'bull'` BullMQ prefix was applied in the DI factory (`env.get('BULLMQ_PREFIX') ?? 'bull'`) instead of in the Zod schema, breaking from the project's established schema-default + `getOrThrow` pattern used elsewhere in `api.schema.ts`, risking the default drifting out of sync if only one of the two sites were ever updated.
